refs.name: taycan
refs.caption: Instrumental hip-hop, future beats, LA beat scene. Mid-tempo head-nodding groove with heavy swing. Punchy sub-heavy kick, dry cracking snare and clap, crisp off-kilter hi-hats. Deep warm rounded synth sub bass. Dusty warm chord pads, a quirky gliding whistle-like synth lead, gritty synth brass swells later. Cool, swaggering, playful, modern. Quick riser straight into the groove, builds with denser synth layers
refs.style: instrumental hip-hop, future beats, swung drums, sub bass, dusty chord pads, gliding synth lead, cool, playful

refs.name: b5
refs.caption: Cinematic darksynth, melodic techno. Fast urgent four-on-the-floor kick, crisp claps on 2 and 4, driving 16th-note hi-hats, white-noise sweeps. Relentless sidechained 16th-note analog saw bassline. Biting reedy lead synth with a dramatic harmonic-minor melody and glide, dark brassy synth pads, rising chord arpeggios. Sleek, tense, nocturnal, high-octane. Filtered pulse and riser intro, hard drop into the hook
refs.style: darksynth, melodic techno, four-on-the-floor, analog saw bassline, reedy lead synth, dark synth pads, tense, nocturnal

refs.name: bmw
refs.caption: Atmospheric trap beat, cloud rap, nocturnal alt R&B. Slow hypnotic half-time bounce. Deep syncopated kick, crisp snare and rimshot backbeat, rolling trap hi-hats, warm sustained gliding 808 sub bass. Lush reverb-drenched minor synth pads and a hazy gliding high synth lead. Nocturnal, sleek, moody, luxury-cool. Steady cruising pocket that swells with fuller layers midway
refs.style: atmospheric trap, cloud rap beat, half-time, 808 bass, rolling hi-hats, reverb synth pads, hazy synth lead, moody, nocturnal

refs.name: sealion
refs.caption: Cinematic trap, hybrid brass trap with phonk undertones. Half-time swagger. Punchy 808 kick, sharp backbeat snare and clap, skittering triplet hi-hat rolls, deep saturated 808 sub bass. Dark low-passed intro, tense synth-string swell and snare riser into a big drop with a bold soaring synth-brass lead over wide minor-key pads. Nocturnal, confident, triumphant, anthemic
refs.style: cinematic trap, brass trap, phonk, 808 bass, triplet hi-hats, synth brass lead, minor pads, big drop, confident, anthemic

refs.name: deepavali
refs.caption: Cinematic world fusion, Indian ambient downtempo, prestige brand score. Unhurried flowing pulse. Sparse organic hand percussion: warm tabla, muted frame drum, subtle shakers, no drum kit. Drone-like low synth bass under lush airy pads. A breathy bansuri flute melody, then a bright plucked sitar-like string lead with an ascending phrase and a resolving cadence. Warm, serene, heritage-rich, quietly uplifting
refs.style: Indian world fusion, cinematic downtempo, tabla, frame drum, bansuri flute, sitar, airy pads, warm, serene, uplifting
